about: The wardrobe catalogue (D611): every body, piece and look characters on Quaternius's bodies are composed from, per slot, by the game (crates/terra_walker/src/wardrobe.rs) and built by tools/characters/build_bodies.sh (a `wardrobe:<body>` step a body), checked by `node tools/characters/wardrobe.ts`. A new piece or look is a row here and a file, never code (D136). slots: what a look fills, one piece each. regions: the parts of a body, each drawn exactly once. bodies: the body's file (`model`: his skeleton, sockets and the fight's clips sampled on him, no mesh); the folder its pieces' game files go in (`pieces`, each <piece>.gltf with its textures shared in textures/); its head piece, shown unless a shown piece holds the head; a bare piece a slot (D600); its default look. pieces: `body` the body it was made on; `source` the file it comes from under art/ (theirs, untouched, D599), with `cut` the region cut_slots.py cuts from it for a bare piece; `slot` (none: the head); `item` the item it is the look of (none: bare skin); `layer` 0 skin, 1 worn; `regions` the body's regions it stands for, so hides; `colourways` their shipped colours it comes in; `dye_mask` its dye regions (later: the paint job); `tags`. looks: a piece a slot, a colourway, hair (none yet: their hairstyles are not vendored). pairings and populations are for later jobs (pairings measured by layers.ts and slots.ts; populations by role).

ranger.about: The starting kit's clothes (D602): the Ranger's body and arms as the leather coat, its leggings as the trousers, its boots.
